subject: Isolation sprint: decomposition, evidence kit & delivery timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Barnes <sarah.barnes@helia.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@veridian.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Isolation sprint: request for decomposition + evidence

Hi Evelyn / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Helia's security team is aiming to close the SIG questionnaire items that relate to network isolation and tenant boundaries for our Dedicated offering. Can you share: 

- A short narrative describing how traffic is separated between Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments (bullet points are fine)
- The most recent network diagram(s) that show control plane vs data plane boundaries for Dedicated and Private
- A checklist of evidence artifacts we can attach to the SIG response (SOC 2 attestation pointers, KMS boundary notes, sample firewall rules)

Our timeline: we'd like the initial evidence packet by end-of-day Friday (UTC). If that's unrealistic, propose a short phased delivery.

Appreciate it — Sarah

--
Sarah Barnes
Senior InfoSec Manager, Helia Health
security@helia.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Barnes <sarah.barnes@helia.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@veridian.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolation sprint: request for decomposition + evidence

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — we can do this. Proposed plan (short, phased):

1) By EOD Thu (internal snapshot): narrative + high-level diagram (control vs data plane) + preliminary checklist
2) By EOD Fri (evidence kit): annotated diagrams, matrix CSV mapping SIG/SOC2 sections to artifacts, and sample firewall/KMS snippets
3) Next Mon: optional deeper dive (live session) to walk through the diagrams and answers

I'll attach the v1 diagrams and the matrix CSV in this thread. Ben will add a few network callouts and the checklist doc.

If you need anything more urgent, flag the specific SIG question IDs and we'll prioritize those.

Cheers,

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Technical Program Manager — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sarah Barnes <sarah.barnes@helia.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolation sprint: request for decomposition + evidence

Attaching the artifacts referenced below. Short notes on contents: 

- isolation-sprint-diagrams.v1.pdf (attached) — 3 pages: page 1 = control/data plane overlay for Dedicated; page 2 = Private (VPC/on‑prem) demarcation; page 3 = prefix/KV cache and egress lanes highlighted
- network-separation-matrix.csv (attached) — maps SIG/CAIQ items to specific artifacts and teams (network, infra, platform)
- evidence-checklist.docx (attached) — checklist with suggested file names to include in the SIG response and the recommended redaction guidance

Key clarifications: 
- Control plane (orchestration/metrics/auth) is hosted in Redwood control region and logically separated from customer data; for Dedicated we deploy a per-customer control-plane namespace with RBAC and audit logging 
- Data-plane isolation for Dedicated is achieved via dedicated GPU pools and tenant network overlays; optional air-gapped private builds are supported for customers requiring stronger physical separation
- Egress: we provide per-deployment egress ACLs, and for Private we recommend an egress NAT/
  proxy owned by the customer to satisfy regulatory routing requirements

I'll mark the attachments with the internal doc IDs in the Drive link. If Helia wants a hardened subset of artifacts for legal review, say so and we'll produce an export set.

- Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Thanks — received and this looks good. We'll start attaching the PDFs to the SIG questionnaire. A couple quick asks before we close: 

- Can you add a single annotated diagram that highlights the shortest path an API request from Helia (Dedicated) takes end-to-end, including where logs/audit events are emitted?
- For the checklist, can you include a suggested filename convention and one-line redaction guidance (PII, IP addresses) so our internal compliance team can ingest without triage?

If you can drop those by Monday morning UTC, we'll mark the SIG items as addressed and move to legal review.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Sarah

--
Sarah Barnes
Senior InfoSec Manager, Helia Health
